clarifyingLead: Before I can help, I need a bit more from you:
clarifyingQuestions: What is your thesis area or the general field you're in (even a rough area is enough)?
Do you have any topic ideas yet, even vague ones, or do you want to arrive with no ideas at all?
What are you good at, or what have you worked on before (courses, jobs, projects) that could guide the topic choice?
clarifyingClosing: Once I have these, I can build a one-page preparation sheet for tomorrow's kick-off meeting with your supervisor.
exampleAnswer:
Here are my answers:
- Field: computer science, roughly data and web development.
- Topic ideas: none yet.
- Background: I liked the databases and web development courses. I work part-time in customer support at a software company and built a small internal FAQ page there.
- Meeting: kick-off, 30 minutes, tomorrow.
